metadata.description: D365Forge: a Dynamics 365 CE delivery team as installable departments. Install only the departments your project needs.

plugins.name: sales
plugins.description: Dynamics 365 Sales delivery: lead to opportunity, sales process stages, products and price lists, quotes and orders, forecasting, sequences, Copilot in Sales and the Outlook and Teams experience.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Customer Insights - Journeys and Customer Insights - Data delivery: journeys, segments, email and text channels, forms and events, consent and preference centres, deliverability, lead scoring and hand-off, and profile unification.

plugins.name: customer-service
plugins.description: Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center delivery: case lifecycle, queues and routing, SLAs and entitlements, knowledge, email-to-case, digital and voice channels, service agents and Copilot, and service analytics.

plugins.name: field-service
plugins.description: Dynamics 365 Field Service delivery: work orders, incident types and service tasks, the schedule board, scheduling optimisation, mobile and offline, inventory and purchasing, customer assets and agreements.

plugins.name: programme-management
plugins.description: Running a CRM project: charter and business case, delivery plan, RAID log, governance cadence, statements of work with partners, and go/no-go decisions.

plugins.name: business-analysis
plugins.description: Turning business need into CRM requirements: process mapping, user stories, fit-to-standard workshops, fit-gap analysis and acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: solution-architecture
plugins.description: The shape of the solution: blueprint, cross-module Dataverse data model, environment strategy, extend-or-configure decisions and performance by design.

plugins.name: platform-engineering
plugins.description: Building on Dataverse and Power Platform: plug-ins, PCF controls, Power Automate patterns, Copilot Studio agents, solution layering and deployment pipelines.

plugins.name: integration-and-data
plugins.description: Moving data in and out of CRM: integration architecture, ERP and Project Operations touchpoints, migration strategy, mapping and cleansing, mock migrations and reconciliation.

plugins.name: data-and-ai
plugins.description: Getting value from CRM data: reporting strategy, Power BI on Dataverse, Fabric link, Copilot and agent enablement, and responsible AI review.

plugins.name: testing-quality
plugins.description: Proving the solution works: test strategy, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression automation for release waves, and performance testing.

plugins.name: change-adoption
plugins.description: Getting people to use the system: stakeholder analysis, communications, role-based training, super-user networks and adoption metrics.

plugins.name: platform-administration
plugins.description: Running the platform: environment setup, licensing and capacity, monitoring, release readiness for release waves, and agent governance.

plugins.name: support-operations
plugins.description: Going live and staying live: cutover planning, hypercare, the support model, incident management and continuous improvement.

plugins.name: design-authority
plugins.description: Reviewer-class: design review, customisation challenge, standards conformance and change impact assessment. Blocking findings are not overruled by the department under review.

plugins.name: security-compliance
plugins.description: Reviewer-class: security model review, business units and teams, field-level security, marketing consent compliance and data retention. Blocking findings are not overruled by the department under review.

plugins.name: project-tailoring
plugins.description: Turns an organisation profile of team, goals and estate into a tailored pack: edition choice, project roles filled from declared skills, skills gaps, and ready-to-complete Word and Excel templates.
